Hey gang!
Finally got a date for 19 June for the Transplant.
Been living with this for 20+ years so excited and of course nervous at the same time.
But holy moly… Diarrhea is implicated three of these drugs, alone!
Anyone with experience who can attest how truly common is this?
Of course everybody is different and I will say that I tolerate drugs pretty well and don’t experience side effects typically (at least not extremely).
I 39F got confirmation today that I have IgAN after a biopsy, I was already on lisinopril, simvastatin and forxiga.
In my last test I had proteinuria of around 1.2 g/l and eGFR of 63, and I will be tested again in 3 months.
I’m wondering now if I can eventually stop taking medication when I’m at normal levels again or will I have to take them the rest of my life to stay stable.
I feel pretty anxious and vulnerable depending so much on meds.
I like to travel a lot and am already thinking what to do if I lose the pills while traveling.
Or what if the production of the pills gets disrupted.
Did anyone take meds at first but not need them anymore later on?
